## Description

Generates realistic, non-Gaussian yield curve movement scenarios using Wasserstein GAN with gradient penalty (WGAN-GP) conditioned on macroeconomic interest rate environments.

## Where it may fit

Fixed income portfolio stress testing, sovereign bond tail-risk scenario generation, interest rate option pricing.

## Vehicles

Fixed Income Arbitrage Funds, Sovereign Debt Desks, Insurance Portfolios.

## Required data

Multi-tenor interest rate yield curves, macroeconomic inflation metrics, central bank policy rate histories.

## Caveats

Discriminator gradient penalty weight hyperparameter requires careful calibration to avoid mode collapse.
